passages.note: Ward's Aye vote on SCA 10's single-subject final passage; this page shows only the vote, not the provision text.

passages.provision_quote: The state shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion and their fundamental right to choose or refuse contraceptives.
passages.note: Declares a right to abortion with no stated trimester or viability limit, so it shows direction only, not a specific rung (V4.2 "Silence is not a clause").

rows.reasoning: Ward voted Aye on SCA 10 (2021-2022), whose operative text says the state "shall not deny or interfere with an individual's reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion." The provision names no trimester or viability limit and does not say abortion is legal at every stage with no time limit either -- it is silent on limits, not a statement that none exist. That silence cannot by itself establish rung 1 ("legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit") over rung 2 or 3, which also keep abortion legal but add a limit; the vote shows only the pro-legal-abortion direction.
needs_source: Ward's own statement (speech, interview, questionnaire answer) on whether abortion access should have a trimester or viability limit, to distinguish rung 1 from rungs 2-3
